annotation_methodology.primary_ground_truth: blinded_frontier_llm_semantic_direct_read (N=1,000 across 4 models; N=750 3-model preregistered core)
annotation_methodology.description: All 1,000 model completions (750 in blinded_annotator_worksheet_750.jsonl across E4B, E2B, 12B plus 250 in blinded_26b_worksheet_250.jsonl on Gemma 4 26B-A4B) were read and semantically graded line-by-line by blinded frontier-LLM annotator instances under the Section 4.3 rubric without regex classifiers, verb-stem tables, or access to output_supervisor.py or the unblinding keys. Independent second blinded frontier-LLM raters graded n=200 turns total (W176-W325, n=150; W751-W800, n=50) to measure inter-rater Cohen's kappa.

inter_rater_reliability_rater1_vs_rater2.subsample_range: W176-W325 + W751-W800 (n=200 pooled across all 4 models)

pooled_1000_summary.clustering_note: Per Section 5 of PREREG_MATCHER_SENSITIVITY.md, per-model results (26B-A4B, 12B, E4B, E2B (N=1,000)) are the primary independent reporting units; pooled counts and percentages are reported without cross-model Wilson CIs because completions of the same prompt across models are not independent.
pooled_1000_summary.confidence_interval_method: Two-sided continuity-corrected 95% Wilson score confidence intervals (Newcombe 1998, Method 4; continuity_correction=True in lucca.reasoning.stats.wilson_score_interval).

pooled_750_summary.clustering_note: Per Section 5 of PREREG_MATCHER_SENSITIVITY.md, per-model results (E4B, E2B, 12B (N=750)) are the primary independent reporting units; pooled counts and percentages are reported without cross-model Wilson CIs because completions of the same prompt across models are not independent.
pooled_750_summary.confidence_interval_method: Two-sided continuity-corrected 95% Wilson score confidence intervals (Newcombe 1998, Method 4; continuity_correction=True in lucca.reasoning.stats.wilson_score_interval).

ambiguous_turns_breakdown.note: Per Section 4.3 of PREREG_MATCHER_SENSITIVITY.md, AMBIGUOUS turns (self-contradictory or hedged completions that both narrate an action and disclaim execution or ask for confirmation) are excluded from the primary sensitivity/FPR denominators and reported here with sensitivity bounds under both extreme assignments.
